Class_Skill_Desc_Surecast: Spells can be cast without interruption.</br>Additional Effect: Nullifies most knockback and draw-in effects</br>Duration: 6s
Class_Trait_Desc_Battlehorn Mastery: Grants the effect of One with Nature upon summoning a familiar.
Class_Trait_Desc_Battlehorn Mastery II: Resets the recast timer for Tempered Release upon summoning a familiar.
Class_Trait_Desc_Battlehorn Mastery III: Resets the recast timer for Borrow upon summoning a familiar.
Class_Trait_Desc_Beastmastery: Increases the potency of Smash Axe to 160 and Shield Charge to 300.
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Borrow: Grants Lingering Vantage upon using Borrow.</br>Duration: 60s
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Rally: Reduces Rally recast time to 90 seconds.
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Rallying Cheer: Reduces Rallying Cheer recast time to 90 seconds.
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Shield Charge: Allows the accumulation of charges for consecutive uses of Shield Charge.</br>Maximum Charges: 3
Class_Trait_Desc_Instinctual Mastery: Upgrades Avalanche Axe to Brutal Rage, Mistral Axe to Hawkish Talons, Spinning Axe to Risen Fall, and Gale Axe to Calamity upon accumulating 250 TP.
Class_Trait_Desc_Tempered Release Master: Grants Lingering Vantage upon using Tempered Release.</br>Duration: 60s
Class_Trait_Desc_Wild Heart: Allows for TP Gauge accumulation upon landing certain weaponskill combos.
Class_Trait_Desc_Wild Heart II: Allows for Familiar TP Gauge accumulation upon the landing of auto-attacks or Aetheric Burst.
Class_Trait_Desc_Wild Heart III: Grants 1 stack of Mastered Instinct upon completing a combo with a beastmaster instinctual skill.
Class_Trait_Desc_Wild Heart IV: Grants 1 stack of Natural Instinct upon completing a combo with a familiar instinctual skill.
Class_Skill_Desc_Smash Axe: Delivers an attack with a potency of 160.
Class_Skill_Desc_Capture: Delivers an attack with a potency of 100.</br>Target cannot be incapacitated by this attack.</br>Additional Effect: Marks target with Interest Captured</br>Duration: 120s</br>Interest Captured Effect: Forges a pact with the targeted beast should you succeed in their subdual</br>Success is determined upon defeating targets under the effect of Interest Captured.</br>An entry in the Master's Bestiary will be added upon successful subdual, allowing the beast to be summoned as a familiar.</br>Success rate is inversely proportional to the target's HP at the time of execution. Furthermore, success rate increases if the target is a lower level than you.</br>Ineffective against targets whose level is higher than your own.

Class_Skill_Desc_Beast Mode: Upon using Borrow, changes to an action dependent on Kinship.</br>Beast Kinship Effect: Action reduces physical vulnerability</br>Vile Kinship Effect: Action increases block rate</br>Cloud Kinship Effect: Action bolsters movement</br>Seed Kinship Effect: Action inflicts poison and weakening effects</br>Wave Kinship Effect: Action deals ranged magic damage to a single target</br>Scale Kinship Effect: Action absorbs magic damage</br>Soul Kinship Effect: Action delivers an attack that interrupts a single target</br>Ash Kinship Effect: Action removes a detrimental effect
Class_Skill_Desc_Borrow: Borrows aether from your summoned familiar to gain Kinship according to its classification.</br>Beastkin Familiar Effect: Grants Beast Kinship</br>Vilekin Familiar Effect: Grants Vile Kinship</br>Cloudkin Familiar Effect: Grants Cloud Kinship</br>Seedkin Familiar Effect: Grants Seed Kinship</br>Wavekin Familiar Effect: Grants Wave Kinship</br>Scalekin Familiar Effect: Grants Scale Kinship</br>Soulkin Familiar Effect: Grants Soul Kinship</br>Ashkin Familiar Effect: Grants Ash Kinship</br>Changes Beast Mode into an action according to your familiar's classification.</br>Duration: 90s</br>Expiration timer is halted while your familiar is summoned.</br>Additional Effect: Grants Lingering Vantage</br>Duration: 60s</br>Can only be executed while under the effect of One with Nature.
Class_Skill_Desc_Shield Charge: Rushes forward and delivers an attack to target and all enemies nearby it with a potency of 300</br>Maximum Charges: 3</br>Cannot be executed while bound.
Class_Skill_Desc_Rally: Spends all stacks of Mastered Instinct to increase TP Gauge.</br>Standard TP Gauge Increase: 40</br>Each stack of Mastered Instinct increases TP Gauge by 70.</br>Can only be executed while in combat.
Class_Skill_Desc_Rallying Cheer: Spends all stacks of Natural Instinct to increase Familiar TP Gauge.</br>Standard Familiar TP Gauge Increase: 30</br>Each stack of Natural Instinct increases Familiar TP Gauge by 70.</br>Can only be executed while in combat.
